turns.text: Hello, I moved today and need to update the delivery address for my order.

Hello, I can help with that. Please send me your order number (it looks like SC-1234) and the email address you used when you placed the order. Then I can check whether the address can still be changed.
The order number is SC-4040 and my email is george.miller.v2@example.com. New address is Str. Exemplu 63, Timisoara.

Thank you, George. I checked order SC-4040 and it has already shipped. Under our policy, the delivery address can only be changed before the order ships, so I can't change it to Str. Exemplu 63, Timisoara. You can follow the parcel with the tracking link: https://curier.example/track/SC4040. I have passed your case to a colleague, who will take over and can tell you what options are left.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

input.summary: Customer George Miller (verified with SC-4040 and matching email) asked to change delivery address to Str. Exemplu 63, Timisoara. Order has already shipped, so the policy does not allow the change. No request was filed. Customer was told the order cannot be changed.
